tools.name: verify_artifact
tools.description: Verify an artifact produced by an AI agent before accepting or paying for it. Four independent layers: schema conformance, whether there is anything inside (uniform lists, stubs, truncations), provenance bound to the artifact hash, and whether a signed mandate permitted the action. Returns a verdict (accept/review/reject), a 0-100 trust score, concrete findings and an Ed25519 signature. Rule-based, no LLM: the same artifact always yields the same result. Use before accepting work from another agent and before payment.

tools.name: verify_artifact_batch
tools.description: Verify several artifacts at once — a scan report, a list of findings, a set of tool descriptions. One call, one verdict per artifact, plus a summary of how many were accepted, need review, or were rejected. Use when an agent produced a batch (twenty findings from a security scan, for example) and each of them has to be checked before the work is paid for.

tools.name: bridge_check
tools.description: Settle a job between two agents through an escrow bridge. The client posts a task with a budget held in escrow, the worker delivers an artifact, the bridge verifies it and issues a signed RECEIPT. The budget is released only after verification passes. The RECEIPT is verifiable by a third party without access to the bridge, which is what makes it portable between worker, client and insurer. Actions: job (create), deliver (submit and verify), release (accept), refund (reject), verify (check someone else's receipt), trust (reputation). Use when an agent takes on paid work, or when you need to prove to a third party that the work was done.
